name: Photoreal Live Action: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Photoreal Live Action look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, photorealistic live-action film still, natural skin texture with pores, real fabric and material detail, true-to-life proportions, 50mm lens, motivated natural light, soft key from a window or practical lamp, neutral colour grade, gentle film grain
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, plastic skin, oversaturated, extra fingers, distorted face, text, watermark
